name: delegated authority
wording: A grant by which the operator leaves the loop for a stretch of work: its scope, which of the operator's sign-offs are taken in its place, the limits that stay the operator's, and an end state. Within it each delegated sign-off is taken and recorded with its reason; whatever stays the operator's is parked while work not depending on it goes on; work running far beyond its size is stopped and recorded with why; the read-back comes once, at the end state. Only through it does anyone but the operator take a sign-off.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history. Restated as its established name and residue, standalone, each fact in the one concept it belongs to, with the meaning standing decisions carried folded in.
